description: TY2025: MFJ, $200,000 wages, itemizing beats the standard deduction. SALT $25,000 (under the $40,000 cap, MAGI below $500k), mortgage interest $18,000 (balance $600k <= $750k, full), charity cash $5,000 (under 60% AGI, no floor in 2025), medical $20,000 - 7.5%x200,000=15,000 -> $5,000. Itemized 25,000+18,000+5,000+5,000=53,000 > std 31,500. TI=147,000. Tax: 2,385 + 8,772 + 22%x(147,000-96,950)=11,011 -> $22,168.00. No Additional Medicare (wages <= $250k MFJ).
